title: Unusual login and unfamiliar IP response
description: Guidance for unfamiliar-IP logins after failed attempts.
conditions: Unfamiliar source IP and/or repeated failed logins preceding a success.
text: When an employee account successfully logs in from an unfamiliar IP after several failed login attempts, analysts must investigate supporting event logs. For a sensitive account, recommend simulated session revocation after human approval. Do not assert compromise without enough evidence.
investigation_guidance: Cite supporting EVT-* IDs, note IP familiarity, and keep compromise language unconfirmed until additional evidence exists.

title: Finance account protection
description: Review guidance for accounts in the Finance department and other privileged roles.
conditions: Account belongs to the Finance department or another privileged role.
text: Finance accounts and other privileged accounts can reach payment systems, so review Finance alerts first and confirm the activity with the Finance account owner. The Finance department never changes the risk score or investigation priority. Business harm is potential unless verified.
investigation_guidance: Review Finance and privileged-account alerts first and confirm with the account owner; the department never raises the risk score or priority.

title: Analyst approval and audit record
description: Human approval and audit requirements for every simulated analyst decision.
conditions: An analyst approves or rejects a proposed response.
text: Only an authorized analyst may approve or reject a proposed response, and nothing executes before that approval. Every simulated decision must record the incident identifier, analyst identity, decision, timestamp and outcome in the audit history.
investigation_guidance: Record one simulated Approve or Reject decision per validated AI report; never claim a real account change occurred.

title: Evidence handling standard
description: Standards for distinguishing observed facts from hypotheses.
conditions: Any AI or analyst explanation of login activity.
text: Investigation summaries must distinguish observed login events from hypotheses. Cite event identifiers for evidence and policy identifiers for guidance. Missing evidence must be stated clearly.
investigation_guidance: Preserve INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when unfamiliar IP alone is present; do not invent missing IP or timestamp context.

title: Spaced-out logins that never reach a sign-in
description: Guidance for failed login attempts that are never followed by a success.
conditions: Several failed logins for one account and no later successful login.
text: Unsuccessful logins observed hours apart, outside any short spike, and never followed by a sign-in may indicate a forgotten credential, a locked account, or slow credential guessing. Analysts should check whether the account is locked, confirm with the account owner, and look for the same source trying other accounts. These logins alone are not evidence of compromise.
investigation_guidance: Cite each failed EVT-* ID, state that no successful login was observed, and keep the classification at INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless more evidence exists.
